Docker-based .NET 8 local stack: MS SQL Server 2025, PostgreSQL 16, Azure Service Bus Emulator; Docker Compose v2+, PowerShell 5.1+, license-free runtimes.

Commands:
.\stack.ps1 start
.\stack.ps1 stop
.\stack.ps1 restart
.\stack.ps1 nuke
.\stack.ps1 status
.\stack.ps1 logs [service]
.\stack.ps1 pull
.\stack.ps1 monitor
docker compose up -d
docker compose down
docker compose down -v
cd servicebus/monitor

Copy `.env.example` → `.env`; fill placeholders. **Never commit `.env`** (it is in `.gitignore`). Never commit `.env` or `servicebus/Config.json`. No secrets in source — `.env` is git-ignored.

Every service must have a `healthcheck` block. Service Bus depends on its internal SQL Server. Passwords: min 8 characters, mixed case, digit, special character. Volumes persist; only `.\stack.ps1 nuke` or `docker compose down -v` removes them. No CI/CD pipelines. No test infrastructure. PowerShell 5.1+ compatibility — do not introduce syntax that requires PowerShell 7+. Keep `.env.example` and `Config.example.json` in sync.
